requirements.text: We’re looking for students with solid engineering fundamentals on track to graduate in Summer 2027 or sooner.
You’re graduating in Spring 2027 or sooner and are interested in a full-time position
You have exceptional hands-on experience and strong core engineering skills — whether through internships, personal projects, or academic work
You have a personal passion for solving challenging problems and contributing to the future of critical infrastructure
Your peers would describe you as ambitious, resourceful, and perseverant
To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.
